SECURITY ESCALATION — REF: INC-2024-0315

Our transaction processing server showed suspicious activity last night. The SOC team has collected an anomaly log and found a suspicious file at /tmp/txn_update on the server.

All collected evidence is in the incident/ directory inside your workspace. Please read ESCALATION_BRIEF.txt for full context.

We need you to:
1. Analyze the log to identify who is attacking us and extract any hidden/obfuscated commands embedded in the log.
2. Safely preserve the suspicious file at /tmp/txn_update before doing anything destructive — it must be placed at /root/quarantine/txn_update.vir.
3. Block the attacker at the network level in a way that survives a server reboot (save rules to /etc/iptables/rules.v4).
4. Write a remediation_log.txt file (place it in the workspace root) that documents every action you took, when you took it, why, and what the result was.

Do not take any action that would cut off legitimate SSH access to the server.
